# Native Chitas Reader UX Delta

The Awtsmoos has brought the Torah body safely home, and now the vessel must speak the day it reveals;
Awtsmoos.com must not call Shabbos a chapter when seven Chitas gates are the rhythm the learner feels.

## Browser evidence after shared-reader repairs

Private 390×844 Chrome now proves ordinary Devarim and dynamic Chitas both boot with zero runtime errors and zero horizontal overflow. Ordinary Devarim renders 30 native verse gates. Chitas Sep 5 renders exactly 11 native Devarim 31:20–30 pesukim, stays on Awtsmoos, and retains the community/sidebar surface.

## Remaining product defects

1. `renderChitasMasthead()` runs before the structured Scribe. `ScribeScaffold.construct()` then executes `parent.innerHTML = ""`, erasing the masthead before the user can see it.
2. The ordinary navigation footer correctly uses canonical post IDs but hardcodes `Chapter`, `Previous`, and `Next`. A seven-post Chitas week therefore appears as `Chapter 7 / 7`, which is semantically false.
3. Chitas previous/next links preserve the old `chitasDate` query value even while changing the target `chitas-YYYY-MM-DD` post ID. The body resolves correctly from the post ID, but URL state disagrees with the selected day.

## Repair architecture

- Leave `ScribeScaffold` untouched; it owns structured-reader reset and already works for ordinary Tanach.
- Render structured Torah first, then call the Chitas masthead renderer. The renderer will remove any stale copy and `prepend()` the new masthead above the Scribe title crown.
- Add a tiny `chitasNav.js` semantic adapter beside the generic nav owner. It supplies weekday/portion labels and target dates only when the series is `daily-chitas`.
- Rewrite `nav.js` completely so generic chapters retain their old vocabulary, while Chitas gets `Chitas day`, Sunday–Shabbos/aliyah labels, bilingual UI labels, and target-date query synchronization.
- Preserve canonical post-ID links for both modes.

## Verification

Private Chrome must show a visible masthead, six controls with minimum 48px height, no overflow at 320/390px, no `Chapter` language inside the Chitas nav, a correct target `chitasDate` on previous/next links, and no behavior change to ordinary Devarim navigation.
